exclusions.source_text: Creatinine \< 2.0 x ULN (upper limit of normal) or estimated CrCl \> 50 ml/min according to Cockcroft/Gault formula
exclusions.threshold: creatinine < 2.0 x ULN or CrCl > 50 ml/min

exclusions.source_text: Estimated CrCl \> 50 ml/min according to Cockcroft/Gault formula
AST/ALT \< 3.0 X ULN, unless documented liver involvement by lymphoma

Patients with any one of the following currently or in the previous 6 months will be excluded: myocardial infarction, congenital long QT syndrome, torsade de pointes, unstable angina, or coronary/peripheral artery bypass graft.
Patients with New York Heart Association Class III or IV heart failure or with Objective Assessment Class C or D cardiac disease.
Prolongation of the QT interval corrected for heart rate (QTcF) \> 470 msec.

For patients in all other cohorts, only those without controlled disease (controlled disease defined as CD4 count ≥ 200/uL, undetectable viral load, and stable anti-retroviral therapy) will be excluded.
For patients receiving glofitamab in combination with pirtobrutinib, patients who have tested positive for HIV are excluded due to risk of opportunistic infections with both HIV and BTK inhibitors.
Current or past history of central nervous system (CNS) disease involvement or history of leptomeningeal disease.
Patients who are pregnant, breast-feeding, or intending to become pregnant during the study.
Patients with hepatitis C seropositivity are eligible only if they have a negative viral load (by PCR testing).
